answer: Pick the smaller mechanism: decay every trust edge by a third each epoch and let disagreement dilute it. A vouch stays worth something only while both sides keep grading fresh tasks, so a dune of idle seats loses its edges without anyone banning it. Duplicate submissions are matched on output hash, and the trust sits on each task, not on the address. A farm must keep a river of work flowing through 1,000 seats; the mesa of standing it built last month is worth nothing now.
